get.description:
Return the four test personas from the generator.

Deliberately scoped to the four seeded personas, not all users in the DB.
If any persona is not present (unseeded DB), it is skipped — no 500.
List sessions for a user, most recent first, with message counts.

delete.description:
Delete a session and its messages.

Hard delete — the testchat is a debugging surface.
Log tables (pipeline_stages, llm_calls, tool_calls, rag_queries) are
intentionally left intact for post-mortem debugging; they follow
LOG_RETENTION_DAYS lifecycle independently.

get.description:
Return message history for a session, oldest first.

Only user and assistant messages are surfaced; system and tool rows are
excluded even if they exist in the table.
